claims.claim: Orders & DME is the per-patient hub for generating and tracking clinical orders. It opens from a patient's chart.
Order types run as tabs across the top: DME, Labs, Imaging, Referrals, Home Health.
For each order you pick a vendor from the enabled-vendor list for that order type (vendors are scoped per clinic).

checks.pattern: const vendorRows = await crmVendorService.list({ scopeFacilityId: facilityId });

checks.note: the list would need to be filtered by order type

claims.finding: The recipient list is this clinic's enabled vendors, scoped server-side by clinic_vendor_enablements, plus home health agencies (PatientOrdersDmePage.tsx:742-751). Since 2026-09-08 it is deliberately NOT filtered by order type (:717-729): every tab shows the same list.
claims.proposed_text: For each order you pick a recipient from your clinic's enabled vendors and home health agencies (the same list on every tab).

proposed_checks.pattern: const vendorRows = await crmVendorService.list({ scopeFacilityId: facilityId });

claims.claim: Optionally choose the vendor's custom form, then send it by fax or email to the vendor. Orders can be saved as a Draft first.
claims.reason: Choosing a form is not optional: after the vendor, the form picker always opens (one or more forms, falling back to the Medipyxis standard forms) — PatientOrdersDmePage.tsx:866-883. Send via Fax is hidden for Mini-plan orgs (:4218-4219).

claims.claim: Each order carries a status: Draft, Submitted, Received, Provisioned, Rejected, Canceled, or Needs Info.
When results come back, use Upload Results on the order.

checks.note: the button must do more than show a toast

claims.finding: Upload Results appears only on Provisioned orders, and its click handler only shows a toast reading "Upload results" — nothing is uploaded (frontend/src/pages/PatientOrdersDmePage.tsx:1606-1617). The working Upload Results menu item is in OrdersTabContent.tsx, used only by OrdersDmeWizard, which nothing imports. Product defect.
claims.proposed_text: Uploading results to an order is not available yet.

claims.claim: During a visit, the Orders & DME section (section 12) of the Visit Wizard opens this surface with the patient context attached.

checks.note: 'opens this surface' needs the wizard to link to the patient Orders & DME page

claims.finding: In the wizard, Orders & DME is badged "Step 11" (VisitWizardV4.tsx:18206-18208; "section 12" is only the stored-data key and the read-only display). It does not open the patient Orders & DME page; it embeds its own ordering panel, OrdersDMEVisit, with the patient id (VisitWizardV4.tsx:18233).
claims.proposed_text: During a visit, the Orders & DME step (Step 11) of the Visit Wizard lets you place orders for that patient without leaving the wizard.

proposed_checks.note: the only Step 11 badge is the Orders & DME accordion (VisitWizardV4.tsx:18207)

claims.claim: Standalone — open a patient's chart and go to Orders & DME to place or track orders outside a visit.
